cards.card_text: Ephraim mixes with the nations, and then the LORD reaches right into my kitchen for a picture: "Ephraim is an unturned cake." Friend, I've pulled that one out of the oven, and the only move is a towel over the pan and a straight face.
cards.verse_text: Ephraim mixes with the nations; Ephraim is an unturned cake.
